requirements.title: CSHIFT ARRAY, SHIFT, and DIM arguments satisfy restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an array; SHIFT shall be integer and scalar for rank-one ARRAY, otherwise scalar or of rank n-1 with the DIM extent removed; DIM, if present, shall be an integer scalar in range 1 through rank n of ARRAY.

pending.cshift-shift-integer-scalar-for-rank-one: Use rank-one ARRAY with scalar integer SHIFT=2 and SHIFT=-2; exact result checks detect sign and magnitude mutations.
pending.cshift-shift-scalar-or-rank-minus-one-sh: Use rank-two ARRAY with scalar SHIFT and with a rank-one SHIFT vector matching the non-DIM dimension; result checks use different shifts per section.
pending.cshift-dim-integer-scalar-in-range: Use DIM=1 and DIM=2 on a rank-two array with different expected results; out-of-range DIM has no diagnostic facet here.

requirements.title: CSHIFT rank-one result uses LBOUND and MODULO indexing
requirements.definition: For rank-one ARRAY, element i of the result is ARRAY(LBOUND(ARRAY,1)+MODULO(i+SHIFT-1,SIZE(ARRAY))).
